name: python-maximum-flow
title: Maximum Flow Walker
blurb: maximum flow over small nonneg-integer-capacity integer-keyed digraphs: the walker's value equals the brute-force min-cut oracle's least on every shipped and seeded corpus, the shipped map conserves at every interior node and never exceeds a capacity, and equal networks ship the same map run after run.
default_description: A flow walker whose value is the cut enumeration's least on every small digraph, and whose shipped map conserves at every interior node.
